inputs.source_scope: Frozen predecessor, rerun unchanged; complete source review recorded in checkpoint130.

unittest.coverage: General constant-cubic divided-difference frame and polynomial inverse in both orders; exceptional good-coordinate replacement and invariant rescaling; theta=0 density failure despite invertibility; nonzero linear-Z bad shear; 225 exact leading signatures at each of two weights, with actual leading coefficients checked; a three-step profile-preserving word; and an explicit seven-shear profile-leaving/reentering word changing C[I], including both inverse-word orders. Four retained130 methods check the derivative gates and recognition-hypothesis boundaries.

bounded_search.root_complete_source_read: db2c74 plus complete inverse-check delta cb9707
bounded_search.family: Four-step commutators of one quadratic and one linear elementary shear among Y,Z,W, with u-exponent zero or one and either sign on the linear shear. Original X=u is fixed. Distinct qualifying endpoints are tested by exact rational coefficient linear algebra. This is a bounded family, not a search over all elementary words.

earlier_author_exploration.scope: Historical author execution of the earlier script, before Root added runtime checks of both inverse-composition orders. Not a peer execution of the current script or of the independent unittest file.

timing_scope: Tool waits are not separately measured process wall-clock durations. Elapsed runtime fields are observational, not deterministic mathematical outputs.
limits: These are exact finite controls, not a computational proof of the universal elementary-word stability theorem. The examples have a coordinate slice X=u; they do not establish entry for nonunit-speed frames or arbitrary sliced derivations. No absence theorem for primitive gate failures, full historical rerun, complete-output checksum, human review, Lean verification, or novelty clearance is claimed.
